title: Share one components.rs between hub and agent-core (move apply_commit_op & co. into mimi-protocol?)
description: mimid-agent-core/src/components.rs and mimid-server/src/hub/components.rs are line-for-line copies (bead mimid-1wgh.13.8); mimid-o5sl had to mirror the protocol-07 §7.6 RepeatedUpdate check by hand. Not merged in mimid-o5sl because no existing shared crate fits without a layering change: mimi-mls cannot see the mimi-protocol / mimi-room-policy codecs; mimi-protocol could hold it but would need a new dependency on mimi-room-policy (crate-map change in AGENTS.md) and would carry hub wording (NotHubTracked, is_hub_tracked). Options: (a) mimi-protocol::components plus mimi-room-policy dep, error variants renamed neutrally, hub and agent re-export; (b) a new small pure crate (e.g. mimi-components) depending on mimi-mls, mimi-protocol, mimi-room-policy. Needs Mark's call on the layering.
notes: Mark 2026-11-19: move into mimi-protocol (it gains a mimi-room-policy dependency); update the AGENTS.md crate map.
close_reason: Done in shared-components worktree commit 75edde5: component update logic moved to mimi_protocol::components, used by hub and agent-core; copies deleted; no behavioural differences between the copies (code identical, docs/visibility only).
